title: 第13章 张鹏你通过考验，收服蝎虎斗罗
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

可就是如此，为他博得了一线生机。

张鹏等了许久，那股足以杀死他的攻击迟迟没有落下来，这让他皱眉。

随后缓缓睁开眼，看到的竟只是千仞雪眼含满意地看着他，哪里还有什么大杀招啊！

这是怎么回事？

对方居然放过他了？怎么可能！

她自称是史莱克学院监察团的人，这不是自诩正义，以斩杀邪魂师为己任的吗？

如今自己这么一个邪恶的邪魂师在眼前，她居然收手了？

“你，你不杀我？”

“对，恭喜你张鹏，你通过我的考验，所以我可以不杀你。”

“为什么？”

“因为在我眼里你不是邪魂师，既不是邪魂师，我为何要杀你？我的这把剑，从来只斩杀真正的邪祟！”

千仞雪昂起头，手中天使圣剑直指前方，表明自己的立场。

可就是这句话，让张鹏的内心受到了极大的触动。

“你，你认为我不是邪魂师？呵呵，小丫头，你看清楚了吗？我的武魂可是邪武魂蝎虎！怎么不是邪魂师了！”

“武魂是邪恶，难道人就一定是邪恶的吗？我不知道其他人如何定义邪魂师，但在我看来，邪魂师从来不能简单的以武魂定性，而是要看这个人的修炼方式与内心。

若武魂邪恶，修炼和为人处世向着光明与正义，从未满手血腥，那这个人就不能被称为邪魂师。张鹏，你便是如此。不是所有人都能经得住天使圣剑的考验，所以，你不是邪魂师。”

“我不是，我不是！哈哈哈哈哈——”

张鹏此刻发出凄然的大笑，却满身悲凉，最后转变为了被认同的淡淡喜悦。

“没想到我此生被无数人叫过邪魂师，今天却被一个女娃娃说不是邪魂师，就算下半生仍旧只能东躲西藏，我也值了。”

“可我觉得不值。张鹏，你真的就想如此认命吗？不想将压迫在你身上的一切污水洗清吗？

凭什么，你根本没有害过人，也没有用邪恶的方式修炼，凭什么被世人指责为邪魂师？只能飘零半生东躲西藏？

But just like that, he won a glimmer of hope.

Zhang Peng waited for a long time, but the attack that could kill him didn't come down, which made him frown.

Then he slowly opened his eyes, and all he saw was Qian Renxue looking at him with satisfaction. There was no big killer move!

What's going on?

The other party actually let him go?How is that possible!

She claims to be a member of the Shrek Academy Supervisory Team. Doesn't she claim to be righteous and take it as her duty to kill the evil soul master?

Now that she was such an evil soul master in front of her, she actually stopped?

"You, you won't kill me?"

"Yes, congratulations Zhang Peng, you passed my test, so I don't have to kill you."

"Why?"

"Because in my eyes you are not an evil soul master, nor an evil soul master. Why should I kill you? This sword of mine has only ever killed real evil spirits!"

Qian Renxue raised her head and pointed the holy angel sword straight ahead to express her position.

But it was this sentence that greatly touched Zhang Peng's heart.

"You, you think I'm not an evil soul master? Haha, little girl, do you see clearly? My martial soul is the evil martial soul scorpion tiger! Why am I not an evil soul master anymore!"

"Martial souls are evil. Do people have to be evil? I don't know how other people define evil soul masters, but in my opinion, evil soul masters can never be identified simply by their martial souls. Instead, they must look at the person's cultivation method and heart.

If the martial spirit is evil, if one practices and conducts his life toward light and justice, and his hands are never full of blood, then this person cannot be called an evil spirit master.Zhang Peng, you are like this.Not everyone can withstand the test of the angel's holy sword, so you are not an evil soul master."

"I'm not, I'm not! Hahahahaha——"

Zhang Peng laughed sadly at this moment, but his whole body was filled with sadness, which finally turned into a faint joy of being recognized.

"I didn't expect that I would be called an evil soul master by countless people in my life, but today I would be called an evil soul master by a girl. Even if I have to hide in Tibet for the rest of my life, it's worth it."

"But I don't think it's worth it. Zhang Peng, do you really want to accept your fate like this? Don't you want to wash away all the sewage that is oppressing you?

Why are you accused of being an evil soul master by the world when you have never harmed anyone or practiced in an evil way?Can you only wander around and hide in Tibet for half your life?
